description.zh:
云导播播流域名。

- 支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
- 若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据。
description.en:
The streaming domain name of the cloud producer studio.

- Supports single or batch domain name queries. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,) for batch queries.
- If this parameter is left empty, merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default.

description.zh:
结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

>结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
查询实例。支持批量实例查询，多个实例用英文逗号（,）分隔。

> 若参数为空，默认返回所有实例合并后数据。
description.en:
The instance to query. Batch query is supported. Separate multiple instances with commas (,).

> If this parameter is left empty, merged data of all instances is returned by default.

description.zh: 指定查询数据的时间粒度，支持3600（1小时）和86400（1天）的取值。单位：秒。
description.en: The time granularity of the queried data. Valid values: 3600 (1 hour) and 86400 (1 day). Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 域名所属地域。若参数为空，默认返回所有Region合并后数据，支持批量查询，多个Region用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The region to which the domain name belongs. If this parameter is left empty, merged data of all regions is returned by default. Batch query is supported. Separate multiple regions with commas (,).

description.zh:
分组键。可以指定domain、region、 instance,、type其中之一或多个, 多个使用英文逗号（,）分隔.。指定了split 的字段将会被分组输出。


>若参数为空, 则只输出按照聚合后数据.
description.en:
The grouping key. You can specify one or more of the following: domain, region, instance, or type. Separate multiple values with commas (,). The specified fields will be grouped in the output.


> If this parameter is left empty, only aggregated data is returned.

description.zh: 开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
导播类型。支持批量查询，多个类型用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：

- **slidelive**：播单型。

- **universal**：通用型。

> 若参数为空，默认返回所有导播类型合并后数据。
description.en:
The producer type. Batch query is supported. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:

- **slidelive**: playlist-based.

- **universal**: general-purpose.

> If this parameter is left empty, merged data of all producer types is returned by default.
The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

descriptions.zh:
最小数据查询粒度为1小时；最大查询时间跨度为31天；支持历史最大查询时间范围为最近90天。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
The minimum data query granularity is 1 hour. The maximum query time span is 31 days. The maximum historical query range is the last 90 days.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API operation is 5 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation properly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-producer-usage-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region cn-shanghai --domain-name example.com --instance a17d0184-462d-4630-b2a6-8c26dde20000 --type slidelive --split-by type --start-time 2018-09-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-10-31T15:59:59Z --interval 3600 --app liveApp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveProducerUsageData --region cn-hangzhou --app liveApp0000 --Type slidelive --EndTime '2018-10-31T15:59:59Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --Instance 'a17d0184-462d-4630-b2a6-8c26dde20000' --SplitBy type --StartTime '2018-09-30T16:00:00Z' --Region 'cn-shanghai' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 3600
